concept.title: When the navigation system is applied

li.p: Speed Limit Offset: Sets an offset to the speed limit. Setting speed adjustments is based on the road speed limit plus the offset value.

Auto Assist: Provides information about speed limits and supplemental signs and issues a warning when driving faster than the speed limit. It can automatically adjust the set speed of Manual Speed Limit Assist or Smart Cruise Control to help comply with the road speed limit.

Manual Assist: Provides information about speed limits and supplemental signs and issues a warning when driving faster than the speed limit. The set speed of Manual Speed Limit Assist or Smart Cruise Control can be adjusted using the (), () switches to help comply with the road speed limit.
Warning: Provides information about speed limits and supplemental signs and issues a warning when driving faster than the speed limit.
Off: Disables Intelligent Speed Limit Assist. The speed limit warning indicator () will be displayed.
Advanced Assist: Displays the upcoming speed limit changes and remaining distance. When the “Auto Assist” menu is selected, the set speed is automatically adjusted if necessary for pre-deceleration.
